metrics.name: cerberus_run_status
metrics.meaning: 1 if the newest run succeeded, 0 if it failed, timed out or was aborted

metrics.name: cerberus_run_step_failed
metrics.meaning: 1 on the step that failed in the newest run, 0 on the other steps

metrics.name: cerberus_last_success_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: End time (Unix seconds) of the newest successful run; written on success only

metrics.name: cerberus_run_started_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: Start time (Unix seconds) of the newest run

metrics.name: cerberus_run_finished_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: End time (Unix seconds) of the newest run

metrics.name: cerberus_dq_passed
metrics.meaning: 1 if the newest run passed data quality, 0 if not, NaN if the suite did not run

metrics.name: cerberus_dq_errors
metrics.meaning: Data-quality errors in the newest run; NaN if the suite did not run

metrics.name: cerberus_dq_warnings
metrics.meaning: Data-quality warnings in the newest run; NaN if the suite did not run

metrics.name: cerberus_run_duration_seconds
metrics.meaning: Wall-clock seconds of the newest run

metrics.name: cerberus_step_duration_seconds
metrics.meaning: Seconds spent in each step of the newest run; NaN for a step not reached

metrics.name: cerberus_run_events_processed
metrics.meaning: Events processed by the newest run; NaN if unknown

metrics.name: cerberus_run_info
metrics.meaning: Always 1; carries the execution name of a run

metrics.name: cerberus_execution_started_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: Start time (Unix seconds) of each run, by execution

metrics.name: cerberus_execution_finished_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: End time (Unix seconds) of each run, by execution

queries.name: latest_finished

queries.meaning: End time of the newest run, Unix seconds

queries.name: last_success
queries.label: Last good data
queries.meaning: End time of the newest successful run, Unix seconds

queries.name: latest_run_seconds
queries.label: Last run duration (seconds)
queries.meaning: Wall-clock seconds of the newest run

queries.name: latest_step_seconds
queries.label: Time per step (seconds)

queries.name: latest_events
queries.label: Events handled
queries.meaning: Events processed by the newest run

queries.name: latest_dq_passed
queries.label: Data checks
queries.meaning: 1 if the newest run passed data quality, 0 if not, NaN if unknown

queries.name: latest_dq_errors
queries.label: Data check errors
queries.meaning: Data-quality errors in the newest run

queries.name: latest_dq_warnings
queries.label: Data check warnings
queries.meaning: Data-quality warnings in the newest run

queries.name: newest_finished_execution

queries.name: newest_started_execution
